utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re set for the repair drive. I’ll handle the headline and keep the rest brief.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good. I’ll keep my part short and only stick to what I know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Let’s keep it practical and move it along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like the repair drive plan nailed down early—who’s handling the donations, and what’s the timeline?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I can help, but I need the source for who’s assigned what before I sign off on it. Do we have a written timeline and donation contact list yet?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, but I’d like us to confirm those in writing before anything moves forward. Once we have the timeline and contact list, I can help keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit behind; what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I think it’s still on for this Saturday, unless I’ve got my days mixed up again. Noah, you’d know better than me—what did we settle on last?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not totally sure—I may have missed the latest update too. I thought we were still aiming for Saturday, but let me check what I have and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, the repair drive’s the plan—I'm telling everyone about it, and we’ll keep pushing the same message so folks know exactly what to bring and when.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I’ll pass it along while I’m out on my rounds, and I’ll keep an ear open for what folks are saying they can donate.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — that’s exactly it, keep repeating the repair drive plan and I’ll do the same so everyone hears the same message about what to bring and when.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late—what’s the repair drive plan so far?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries—we’re keeping it pretty loose: folks can swing by, drop off repairs, and I’ll help sort what needs tools or hands. We’ve just got to get a few things organized and see what shows up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I'll help sort things when I get there. Just point me to what needs tools or an extra set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d rather keep to a clear plan for the repair drive and not keep changing it once we settle on one.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally fair — let’s lock the plan in and I’ll stop tweaking it. Once we agree, I’ll spread the word exactly as-is.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that suits me fine. Let’s keep it simple and steady once we’ve set it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much is the repair drive raising, and what exactly are the funds going toward?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure on the exact total yet, but it’s going toward the needed repairs and materials for the drive. I can check the numbers and get you the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need the exact amount and a breakdown of the repairs and materials. Please get me the numbers before we move forward.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m in for the repair drive — I can help round up folks from both groups and keep everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll keep the route and timing tight, and you can help me coordinate both groups. If you hear of any stragglers, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out for anyone who needs a nudge and send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m glad we’re finally talking about the repair drive—let’s keep the original plan in mind and make sure we follow through on what we promised.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep us anchored to the original plan and make sure everyone’s clear on what we promised. I’ll double-check the details and keep the group updated so nothing slips.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds right, Rosa—thank you for keeping it steady. Let’s make sure we follow through exactly as promised and keep everyone informed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve noted the repair drive, but I don’t have any supplies or commitments recorded for it yet. Tell me what’s needed, and I’ll write it down carefully.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—just the basics for now: I’ll need the parts list, any tools, and who’s bringing what. I’m between rides, so keep it short and I’ll lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got it: parts list, tools, and who’s bringing what. Tell me the names, and I’ll record them neatly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up steam already — people are dropping off tools and supplies faster than expected. I’m not sure who organized the biggest part of it yet, but it sounds like the neighborhood’s really showing up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’s good to hear. I’m not sure who’s leading it, but I’m glad people are stepping up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I know, right? If I hear who’s coordinating the main drop-off, I’ll let you know — it already sounds like it’s turning into a really solid effort.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to verify the details first—what exactly is being repaired in the drive, and who confirmed it?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s the school repair drive, and I’m checking the list now—I don’t want to guess. Once I confirm who signed off, I’ll send you the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—please send the confirmed list and sign-off once you have it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Ira, I’m in between rides right now—what’s the gist of the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly folks are dropping off tools, spare parts, and a little cash for the workshop fixes. I heard it’s picking up nicely, but they’re still hoping for a few more hands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that’s good to hear. I can swing by if they still need another set of hands between fares.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — let’s keep the repair drive rolling and I’ll spread the word the same way everyone else is saying it. If there’s a plan already taking shape, I’ll stick with that.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great—let’s keep it simple and consistent so it spreads fast. I’ll check the plan and pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll keep repeating the simple version so it sticks, and I’ll pass it along exactly the same way.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still checking what’s actually needed. I’ll only say more once I’m sure.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—thanks for checking first. I’ll wait for your update once you’ve confirmed what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m in — I just need the time and place for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — I’ll get the exact time and spot sorted and let you know soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — I’ll keep everyone posted on the repair drive and double-check any changes so nobody’s left guessing. If anything shifts, I’ll update the group chat right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — that’s exactly what I’d expect. Keep me posted with the exact time and address once it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send the exact time and address as soon as it’s confirmed, and I’ll make sure the group chat has the same info too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to pin down the schedule first—when are we starting the repair drive, and who’s bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let’s kick off at 10 on Saturday, and I’ll send the final sign-up list around tonight. I can bring clipboards, tape, and coffee—what can I put you down for?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great—put me down for the labels and a sign-in sheet. I’ll wait for the list tonight so I can check the gaps before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not moving on this without confirmation and a source. What exactly do we know about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: We only know what’s been confirmed so far: there’s talk of a repair drive, but I haven’t seen a source I trust yet. I’d rather verify it before we act.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That’s fair—send me the source when you have it, and I’ll look at it before we do anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m good with a fixed plan—just tell me the repair drive details, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — what time are we meeting, and what should I bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s meet at 9:00 sharp, and bring the tools, a flashlight, and the parts list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive from around the block—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I don’t have a fresh update recorded yet, but I’m keeping an eye on it. If I hear anything definite, I’ll note it down and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Cleo — I’m still piecing it together from the neighborhood chatter, so I’ll keep my ears open too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, though I may need a little reminder on where and when we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — we’re meeting at the community shed on Saturday at 10. I’ll bring the sign-up sheet and the coffee.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday at 10 at the community shed — got it. I’ll be there, and I’ll lend a hand however I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need it to fit around school pickup first. What time window are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Early afternoon works best. Say 1 to 3, if that fits.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 1 to 3 should work if I can be out by pickup. I’ll confirm once I’ve checked the school run.
